messages:
emma: @product heads up — Ionix (pilot customer) reported a regression in rerank relevance after we rolled the q4 embedding profile yesterday. They measured top-3 precision drop from ~82% -> ~61% on their eval set. Latency improved ~30ms but customer is worried about quality and is asking for prioritization. Logs + small eval summary: s3://redwood-cs/onyx/ionix_eval_2026-03-18.json :eyes:

ajay: thanks emma — is this failure isolated to the rerank step or is retrieval impacted too? can you paste the eval snippet here?

emma: pasted excerpt below and attached full file to the ticket. snippet:
```
model: emb-q4
dataset: ionyx-prod-150
top1: 0.56
top3: 0.61
MRR: 0.72
notes: drop concentrated on long-tail documents with high token counts
```
They confirm retrieval recall is roughly unchanged.

taylor: @ajay @sam I ran a quick local repro this morning. Likely cause: quantization-induced distortion in cosine distances for longer vectors + lack of per-dim rescaling we normally use in emb32. That reorders nearest neighbors for borderline cases and cascades into rerank. I can run an AB comparing emb32 vs emb-q4 on 50k Ionix queries. Early hint: per-dim scaling + cosine-correction narrows gap.

sam: this is customer-revenue-impacting. Proposed short/medium/long plan: 1) Short: implement a fallback rule at rerank layer — if rerank confidence delta < threshold then re-score with emb32 (safety net). 2) Medium: add calibration step and recommend quantization profile changes + automated eval. 3) Long: if needed retrain or re-fine-tune embedder for Ionix domain. Launch/acceptance criteria: restore top3 precision to within 5% of their baseline on their eval set, and keep latency hit <=10%.

leo: quick estimates: fallback gating + config flag + rollout ~1 eng day. AB pipeline + analysis ~3 eng days. Calibration + model onboarding ~2-3 weeks if we need to retrain.

emma: Ionix is asking for a firm ETA; they need an answer before EOM to proceed with contract terms.

ajay: recommended roadmap action: create a mid-priority initiative "rerank quantization stabilization" on the backlog. Owner: taylor (ML Eng), PM: ajay. Acceptance criteria per Sam. If Ionix signs a contract we escalate to high priority and allocate Dedicated capacity.

taylor: I'll draft an experiment plan and a runbook. Also we should add a small Console change: per-route eval uploads so CS can drop customer eval sets and run the baseline/experiment automatically. That might be a small product scope item (UI + backend).

sam: rollout policy suggestion: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%, with automatic rollback if top3 precision drops >4% absolute or latency increase >20% relative. Add monitoring dashboards and an evaluation check at each stage.

ops-bot: Reminder: create ticket in JIRA: CS-IONYX-1423 and attach artifacts.

emma: created CS-IONYX-1423 and uploaded eval JSON, console screenshots, and sample failing queries. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-IONYX-1423 :thumbsup:

ajay: I'll add this to the quarterly roadmap board and ping legal/sales for timing risks. tagging stakeholders: @sam @taylor @leo. Next actions: taylor to deliver AB plan by EOD tomorrow; emma to keep Ionix updated with interim mitigation (fallback plan).

emma: noted. I'll tell them we have a mitigation path and an expected experiment by next week.

sam: thanks all. leaving acceptance criteria and owner in the ticket. We'll reconvene after the AB results. :white_check_mark:
